Title: BScN Programme Receives Pre-Accreditation by NLN CNEA (USA)
NewsSummary: This achievement sets a new standard for nursing education in Pakistan
NewsContent:
The Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BScN) Programme at AKU's School of Nursing and Midwifery (SONAM)  has achieved a great feat by receiving pre-accreditation from the National League for Nursing Commission for Nursing Education Accreditation (NLN CNEA), USA. This recognition solidifies AKU's position as Pakistan's first and only nursing school to earn such an accolade.

The NLN CNEA, a renowned autonomous division of the National League for Nursing, is dedicated to fostering excellence and integrity in nursing education worldwide. SONAM's pre-accreditation is a testament to its unwavering commitment to providing top-tier nursing education. This milestone not only elevates AKU's reputation but also aligns it with global standards in nursing education.

This pre-accreditation status qualifies SONAM to seek full accreditation from the NLN CNEA, by 2027.  Over the next three years, SONAM will assess and improve its processes and programmes to excel further along the five key standards of NLN CNEA:

The first standard emphasizes a Culture of Excellence, requiring the programme to show a commitment to achieving high-quality outcomes and demonstrating the effectiveness of its educational strategies.

The second focuses on Integrity and Accountability, ensuring that governance and resource management are aligned with the institution's mission, promoting transparency and a sense of purpose.

The third and the fourth standards are about Excellence in Caring, demonstrated by students and faculty respectively.

Finally, the fifth standard requires the programme to be committed to fostering a Culture of Learning and Diversity, offering a robust curriculum that addresses diverse learning needs and adapts to evolving healthcare trends.

SONAM's achievement in receiving the NLN CNEA pre-accreditation and in its preparation to seek the full accreditation, it will continue to excel in nursing education and practice to meet the ever-changing healthcare needs of the population in Pakistan and globally.
